changes: Released 2026-11-27 (XC_VM-GO, unofficial fork based on XC_VM 2.7.4).

Go live channels reconnect like FFmpeg with the panel timings: when the source is down or sends nothing (under 256 KB before first_video, or silent longer than segment_wait_time), Go exits and XC_VM restarts the channel after stream_fail_sleep, still on Go. Source cuts no longer count toward the '3 failures in 10 min' rule, so unstable sources stop ending up permanently on FFmpeg.
FFmpeg takes over only for a real incompatibility: the source sends data but Go finds no video in it.
Panel: channels started before an update replaced the Go binary were shown as FFmpeg (Linux reports the old file as 'ffmpeg-golive (deleted)'); they are shown as Go again.
Includes everything from 2.7.4-p6 (ckts sound check on a small AAC decoder, fewer PHP starts) and 2.7.4-p5 (ckts sized to the server).
